subject: Post-call recap: Crestline buying path & security artifact commitments
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@crestline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Crestline buying path & security artifact commitments

Hi Maria / team,

Great to meet this morning — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: validate POC success criteria and confirm procurement/security gating items for a production pilot (Q1 2029).
- Economic buyer: Jeff Allen (CFO) — expects a clear ROI and 30–60 day procurement window.
- Procurement lead: Angela Park (contracts/procurement).
- Security contact: Dave Huang (secops) — their primary asks are SOC 2 attestation, pen-test outcomes or schedule, and audit-log/retention proof points.

Commitments / deliverables from Redwood (owners & target dates):
1) SOC 2 attestation (scoped): Connor to deliver the latest attestation PDF by EOD today — attached. (Owner: Connor)
2) Pen-test scoping & standard Qs: Connor to send our standard pen-test questionnaire + proposed scoping call times; proposed target: scoping this month, test before month-end if possible. (Owner: Connor)
3) Audit logs sample & retention policy: Marissa to provide a short example + documentation on retention windows and export capabilities by next Thu 11/22. (Owner: Marissa)
4) Procurement template & commercial path: Rishi to draft a single-page procurement checklist and pricing note for Dedicated/Hosted options by 11/21. (Owner: Rishi)

Decision criteria we logged during the call:
- Security baseline: SOC 2 + either public pen-test report or scheduled pen-test with agreed scope.
- Data handling: ability to produce audit logs and define retention policy (30/90/365d options).
- Economics: predictable unit costs + option for reserved capacity if they want throughput SLAs.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2028-11.pdf (attestation), draft procurement checklist (outline).

Next steps / asks for you:
- Can you confirm the procurement timeline / decision date for Jeff and Angela?
- Who should we invite to the pen-test scoping call (security engineer name / preferred windows)?
- Any internal compliance forms we should expect to fill out?

I'll follow up with specific calendar options for a 30-minute pen-test scoping call and add Marissa & Rishi to the thread for artifact delivery.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2028-11.pdf (PDF, 480KB)
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@crestline.com>

Cc: Jeffrey Allen <jallen@crestline.com>, Angela Park <apark@crestline.com>, Dave Huang <dhuang@crestline.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Crestline buying path & security artifact commitments

Connor — thank you for the clear summary. That aligns with our conversation. A few clarifications and a small ask from procurement: 

1) Timeline: our internal target is to complete procurement approvals by 12/15/2028 (so pilot start in early Jan). Jeff wants any outstanding security artifacts delivered by 11/27 so legal has time to review.

2) Pen-test: Dave asked whether you provide a third-party pen-test report or whether we should schedule a new test scoped to our environment. If you can share your standard questionnaire (scope + typical timelines) that will help. Prefer scoping call next Wed or Thu (11/22 or 11/23) between 10–2 PT.

3) Audit logs / retention: our compliance reviewers need a concrete statement that audit logs for API access are available with at least 90 days retention and the ability to export to S3, plus a short sample of what log lines look like.

I attached our procurement timeline spreadsheet — it has the key approvers and gating dates. Please confirm whether the SOC 2 PDF you attached is the full attestation or a summary.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Senior Program Manager — IT Procurement
Crestline Systems

Attachment: crestline_procurement_timeline.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Crestline buying path & security artifact commitments

Thanks Maria — appreciate the timeline and the spreadsheet. To answer your questions and propose concrete next steps: 

1) SOC 2 attestation: the attached PDF is our full Type II attestation (2028 reporting period). It's the audit report issued by our auditor; let me know if legal needs the auditor contact.

2) Pen-test approach: attached is our standard pen-test questionnaire and a short scoping checklist (pen-test-questions_crestline.xlsx). Our usual flow — scoping call, test window scheduling, remediation window (2 weeks) — means we can often finish a standard test within 3–4 weeks from scoping. If you can do 11/22 or 11/23 10–2 PT for scoping, I'll send calendar invites.

3) Audit logs / retention: Marissa will provide a short sample and a one-page export walkthrough. For your compliance note here is a short capability summary: we retain API access logs for 90 days by default (configurable to 365 days on Dedicated), and logs can be exported to customer-managed S3 buckets; we can provide an anonymized sample log extract. Attached is a one-page description of the sample export format (audit-logs-sample-description.txt).

Stakeholder map (for clarity):
- Economic buyer: Jeffrey Allen (CFO) — key success: cost predictability + support SLA.
- Procurement: Angela Park — legal / contract gating.
- Security / compliance: Dave Huang — technical gating (SOC2, pen-test, logs).
- Implementation manager: Maria Lopez — POC + pilot orchestration.

Action items: 
- Connor: schedule pen-test scoping call for 11/22 @ 11:00 PT (proposed) and resend the pen-test questionnaire. (DONE: calendar hold pending confirmation)
- Marissa: send audit log sample & S3 export steps by 11/22.
- Rishi: share procurement checklist + pricing lanes for Hosted vs Dedicated by 11/21.

Links for reference: HubSpot opportunity (link below) and contract template (DocuSign).

Attachments: pen-test-questions_crestline.xlsx, audit-logs-sample-description.txt, Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2028-11.pdf

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Team — looping you all in with the external thread so we have a single place for asks. Highlights and asks: 

1) Marissa: can you prioritize producing the anonymized audit-log extract and the S3 export steps? Maria asked for the sample by 11/22; please flag if we need any engineering support. Deliverable: audit-logs-sample-description.txt + an example gzipped extract (anonymized).

2) Rishi: procurement wants a simple pricing lanes doc (Hosted vs Dedicated) and a short note on pricing impact if they require 365d retention or dedicated capacity. Can you draft by 11/21? Also prep a procurement checklist with the DocuSign link.

3) Stephanie: after Marissa produces the sample, can you work with Solutions to prepare a 1-pager that maps compliance asks -> product capabilities (SOC2, pen-test cadence, logs export)? That will help Jeff and legal.

I'll coordinate the pen-test scoping call with Maria and Dave for 11/22 at 11:00 PT. If anyone needs to push on timelines, call it out now — procurement is driving a 12/15 decision.

Thanks — Connor
